name: sim_checkpoint_roundtrip_high_water
description: The codec round-trips every field M2 added: the busy three-seat match of sim_checkpoint_roundtrip_busy, played in High Water by three Lookouts (two by command, one caretaken; with nobody covering Swarm or Swift they fork Kestrel Flocks and Pinning Ballistas) (Owl's Eyes holding their marked creeps, Kestrel Flock bounces in the air, marks, slows, Help), replayed into a simulation replaced by deserialize(serialize()) every 7 ticks and every 61 with events on: every tick's hash equals the uninterrupted run's.

steps.eval: [rec['final_tick'], rec['over'], rec['wave'], rec['towers'], rec['most_marked'], rec['bounces_seen'], rec['help']]

steps.msg: the busy High Water match ran six and a half minutes, past the first Duskmoths and the Bristlesow

steps.assert: rec['most_marked'] >= 1 and rec['bounces_seen'] > 0 and rec['help'][0] + rec['help'][1] + rec['help'][2] > 0
steps.msg: Owl's Eyes held their creeps, bounces flew and Help was earned

steps.assert: every7['first_bad'] == -1 and every7['final'] == rec['final_tick'] and every7['trips'] > 1000
steps.msg: a round trip every 7 ticks keeps every tick's hash
and every 61 ticks with events on
